## Origin

This vulnerability was identified by Team RabbitMQ and/or other teams at Broadcom, not via a responsible disclosure from an external researcher.

## Impact

OTP's default 10M `match_limit` caps each call at roughly 100-200ms, but the regex runs once per resource in the result set. With a large set, for example 5000 queues at 150ms each, a single request consumes 12 or more minutes of CPU. Parallel requests saturate the schedulers. The `use_regex=true` option is a supported feature on list endpoints, so this path is reachable through normal API use.

## Description

`match_value/3` passes the user-supplied `?name=` regular expression to `re:run` with no `match_limit` option, and executes it once per resource in the result set.

## Preconditions

Any user with the `management` tag can exploit this.

## CVSS
CVSS v4.0: `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N` (6.0, Moderate). Fixed in `3.13.15`, `4.0.20`, `4.1.11`, `4.2.6`, `4.3.0`.
